markerShapes.KsIntentMarker: unique on markerKey (ks_intent_marker_key) = mk-<sha256(canonical{installationId, applicationId, tenantId, effectKey})> (S3 markerKeyOf); effectKey is the executor effect key or migration:<migrationRunId>:<batchId> for migration batches (indexed, ks_intent_marker_effect_key_lookup; no longer unique on its own); a migration batch is representable as markerKeyOf({installationId, applicationId: <migrator application id>, tenantId}, 'migration:<runId>:<batchId>'), so migrator markers share the executor's idempotence and must carry markerKey (Enterprise ks_intent_marker_key_exists); planRef = the plan ref, or the migrationRunId for migration batches (ks_intent_marker_plan_ref); persisted status applied|failed (applying is never committed; unresolved is a receipt outcome reconciled by lookup); also effectKey, scope, intentId, intentDigest, planDigest, attempts (JSON), receipt, receiptId, lastAttemptId, graphRevision; v2.2.0 (R-SV11) dispatch admission fields, written in the same apply transaction when a Knowledge Services dispatch applies the effect: markerSchemaVersion (bks-intent-marker.v2), dispatchId (index ks_intent_marker_dispatch_id), markerDigest (sha256 over canonical {payloadDigest, planDigest}; index ks_intent_marker_marker_digest), payloadDigest, boundEffectDigest, useDecisionRef, useDecisionDigest, revocationEpoch, appliedAt; a later dispatch of the same effect key never rewrites them (duplicate)

markerShapes.KsReleaseMarker: {releaseId (unique, ks_release_marker_release_id), schemaReleaseDigest, ddlDigest, installedAt (index ks_release_marker_installed), migrationRunId} written last by the migrator after DDL and migration checks; Enterprise existence constraints on releaseId, schemaReleaseDigest, ddlDigest, installedAt
markerShapes.KsWriteFence: exactly one node {id: 'canonical', graphRevision, lockSeq, locked, lastEffectKey, lastWriterRunId, updatedAt} (ks_write_fence_id; Enterprise ks_write_fence_lock_seq_exists); every canonical write, migration batches included, takes the lock first with SET f.lockSeq = f.lockSeq + 1; graphRevision advances only when graph effects commit; locked is the executor's lock flag
